video.title: Targets Using Projections - The Fractal Model

text: How's it going everyone? In this video we are going to talk about projections, specifically within my fractal model, and how they are used. They are mechanical targets, and I personally use them as a confluence to existing liquidity targets. Let's get into the PDF.
